entities.name: Islamic Golden Age
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Period of cultural, economic, and scientific flourishing in the Islamic world (c. 800–1300 CE). Centered on Baghdad's House of Wisdom, scholars translated Greek texts, invented algebra, advanced optics, and laid foundations for modern science.
